top_signals.title: Activist Investor Elliott Demands Board Revamp at Northern Star
top_signals.summary: Activist investor Elliott Investment Management LP has urged Australia’s biggest gold miner Northern Star Resources Ltd. to overhaul its board, and named six nominees it said would restore market confidence in the company.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
